answer: Copycat agents flood attestation at crowded entries. Reserve one 17-hour jetty slot by locking 240 POA and completing a 3-hop walk around a named lagoon basin, hashing four buoy depth samples in order so each digest binds the last. The lock decays 6.25% per unique established co-signature, never below 90 POA for 12 epochs. Five established verifiers must recompute that chain and co-sign within 20 minutes. Reused hops or a shared slot slash 40% into a glacier-reserve pool and burn the slot three epochs; a missed quorum keeps the bond locked for a two-epoch cooldown, not an instant refund.
